description: This is a comprehensive documentation markdown file describing the HDMIOutput HAL interface for a platform. It details the overview, features, APIs, capabilities, state machines, event handling, and system contexts related to the HDMI output hardware abstraction.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported capabilities (video formats, colorimetry, pixel formats, HDCP versions, HDR modes) for an HDMI output resource.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing HDCP authentication states such as AUTHENTICATED, UNAUTHENTICATED, or UNKNOWN.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the HDR mode currently enforced or supported.

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enum for identifying the Source Product Description Frame source types like DVD, BluRay, PC, etc.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Enumeration for HDMI Video Identification Codes representing supported HDMI video modes.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Key-value pairs representing configurable properties for HDMI output such as VIC, content type, AFD, HDR mode.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the HDMI output, including supported formats, color spaces, HDR modes, and other features.
